title: fix: keep line breaks in transaction notes when the notes field is only focused
issueTitle: [Bug]: When focusing Notes field to select text - it removes a space in the text on unfocus
why: The bug only shows on notes imported from a bank (GoCardless/Danske Bank) that probably contain a hidden character such as a line break, which a user cannot type into the single-line Notes field, and the report says it does not know whether manually entered notes are affected.
